tei:div.tei:p: ca) pa la/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi sgrub mchod bcas bshams tho dang 'don zin kun gsal me long*/ chos spyod kyi rim pa thar lam rab gsal/

slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i gsol 'debs le'u bdun ma/ snga 'gyur rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs spyi 'gro/ kun mkhyen bla ma 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i rnam thar gsol 'debs bkra shis 'khyil pa'i sgra dbyangs/ dpal ldan bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa kun tu bzang po'i sgra dbyangs/ sprul pa'i gter chen mchog gyur bde chen gling pa'i rnam thar gsol 'debs bkra shis 'khyil pa'i dbyangs snyan/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs pad+ma'i rgyud mangs/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ sngon 'gro dang bcas pa'i rim gnyis rgyun gyi rnal 'byor/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ rdo rje phag mo'i phrin las/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ dpa' bo dpa' mo'i sgrub thabs/ sman gyi brgyud mchod/ dzab khang dbye ba/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ phag mo'i nye bsnyen/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ bka' srung mched gsum gtor 'bul rgyun khyer/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ rgyun gyi tshogs skong mdor bsdus/ rdo rje phag mo gsang ba kun 'dus kyi tshogs mchod nyer bsdus/ mkha' 'gro gsang 'dus kyi tshogs shin tu bsdus pa 'bum ther bsags skabs lta bur grangs gsogs/ kun mkhyen bla ma rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gsol 'debs/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ rdzogs chen ma rgyud mkha' 'gro gsang ba lam khyer kyi bstod bskul khol du phyung ba/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus la sbyar rgyu'i chad tho/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ rdo rje phag mo'i mchod skong*/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus mchod skong bye brag pa drug gi skabs su spyan 'dren mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya ba tshan gnyis/ 'byung lnga'i skong ba'i las bye brag pa rnams la 'dod gsol rgyas par bya ba/ mchod bstod nongs bshags mdor bsdus/ mkha' 'gro yongs rdzogs mchod cing thugs dam skong ba'i mdos kyi cho ga mkha' dbyings rol pa'i rgyan/

/mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi mdos skong mdor bsdus/ mkha' 'gro'i smre bshags/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ rdo rje phag mo'i tshe sgrub/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ rdo rje phag mo'i nor sgrub/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ rdo rje phag mo'i dbang sdud/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ rdo rje phag mo'i zor las/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ phag mo 'dus pa'i dbang bskur/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ rdo rje phag mo'i gtor dbang*/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ rdo rje phag mo'i zab khrid/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ rdo rje phag mo'i rtsa ba'i phrin las 'bring po bde chen grub pa'i myur lam/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga bde chen bdud rtsi'i bum bzang*/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi sminagrol 'bogs pa'i bklag chog ḍā kī'i 'dzum zer/ mkha' 'gro gsang 'dus kyi phag mo khros ma'i bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pa'i ngag 'don/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi 'pho rdzas bsdu ba'i rim pa/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus las/ gnas lung gi cho ga lhan skyes thugs rje'i pho nya/
